title: Niagara Falls Day Tour from Toronto: Cruise & Behind Falls
blurb:
Experience one of the most complete Niagara Falls day tours from Toronto on this small-group sightseeing experience with boat cruise, maple syrup tasting, and wine tasting, designed for comfort, flexibility, and a more personal alternative to large bus tours.
Depart from Toronto with hotel pickup or meeting points and travel in a comfortable, air-conditioned vehicle along scenic highways. Enjoy key stops along the Niagara Parkway, including the Floral Clock and Niagara Whirlpool Rapids. (seasonal). Visit Maple Leaf Place for a guided tasting of three Canadian maple syrups with local chocolate and time for snacks and a washroom break. Spend approximately 4 hours at Niagara Falls with free time to explore. In summer, enjoy the Niagara City Cruises boat ride (Hornblower). In winter, it is replaced with Journey Behind the Falls or Niagara Takes Flight. End your day with a Niagara wine tasting featuring regional wines and Ice Wine before returning to Toronto with convenient drop-off points.
